roles.title: Odoo Developer
roles.summary: We are looking for an **Odoo Developer** with 2 to 4 years of hands-on Python and Odoo framework experience to build and extend the modules our customers run their business on.
responsibilities: Build and customise Odoo modules across sales, purchase, inventory, POS and HR
Extend existing modules with new fields, views, workflows and reports
Integrate Odoo with our mobile apps, POS terminals and payment devices
Migrate customer databases between Odoo versions
Debug issues reported from live customer servers and ship the fix
Document what a module does, so the next person does not have to guess
requirements: Strong Python, with day-to-day Odoo ORM experience
Comfortable with XML views, QWeb reports and OWL components
PostgreSQL and SQL — enough to read a slow query and fix it
Git, and the discipline to work on a shared branch
Able to read an existing module properly before rewriting it
eligibility: B.Tech / MCA / BCA, or equivalent practical experience
2–4 years of Odoo development, preferably in a product or services company

roles.title: Frontend Developer
roles.summary: We are looking for a **Frontend Developer** with 2 to 4 years of React and Next.js experience to build the interfaces our customers — and our own team — use every day.
responsibilities: Build responsive interfaces in React and Next.js from designs
Work in Tailwind CSS and keep the design system consistent across pages
Support right-to-left layouts properly for our Arabic-speaking customers
Connect screens to Odoo and internal APIs
Keep pages fast — images, bundle size and Core Web Vitals
Test on real devices, not only a desktop browser
requirements: Strong JavaScript and TypeScript
React, with practical Next.js App Router experience
Tailwind CSS or a comparable utility-first framework
HTML and CSS deep enough to build a layout without a component library
Git, and the accessibility basics — labels, focus order, contrast
eligibility: B.Tech / MCA / BCA, or equivalent practical experience

roles.title: System Administrator
roles.summary: We are looking for a **System Administrator** with 2 to 5 years of experience to keep our Odoo servers, networks and customer installations running — including the on-call rotation behind our 24/7 support.
responsibilities: Install, configure and maintain Linux servers running Odoo and PostgreSQL
Take backups — and restore them regularly, to prove they work
Set up networks, POS terminals, kiosks and printers at customer sites
Monitor uptime and respond to incidents on the on-call rotation
Manage users, permissions, SSL certificates and firewall rules
Keep an accurate inventory of what runs where
requirements: Linux administration on real production servers (Ubuntu / Debian)
PostgreSQL basics — backup, restore, users, and reading the logs
Networking: DHCP, DNS, VPN and firewalls
Shell scripting for anything you do more than twice
A calm head during a production incident
eligibility: Diploma / B.Tech / BCA in computer science, or equivalent experience
2–5 years administering Linux servers in production

roles.title: Accountant
roles.summary: We are looking for an **Accountant** to keep our own books the way we tell our customers to keep theirs — in Odoo. You will own day-to-day accounting for a growing ERP and hardware company and work directly with management.
responsibilities: Handle day-to-day bookkeeping in Odoo Accounting — journals, ledgers and vendor bills
Raise customer invoices and follow up on payments and receivables
Reconcile bank and cash accounts every week
Prepare GST filings and TDS workings with our auditor
Produce monthly P&L, receivables and expense reports for management
Support payroll inputs, expense claims and petty cash
requirements: B.Com or equivalent qualification
1–3 years of hands-on accounting experience
Working knowledge of Tally or Odoo Accounting
Familiarity with GST returns and basic TDS
Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets
eligibility: Based in or willing to relocate to Kollam
